info.title: MandalHisab API
info.description: Ganpati Mandal Financial Management System API. All responses use a standard envelope: `{success, statusCode, message, data, meta}`. Money amounts are INR with max 2 decimals. Calendar dates use `YYYY-MM-DD`, timestamps use ISO-8601 UTC.

get.description: Public configuration: version, maintenance mode, feature flags, support contacts.

post.summary: Logout (revokes refresh token, optionally all sessions)

currentPin.description: Required when changing an existing PIN

post.summary: Create a new mandal (caller becomes ADMIN)

put.summary: Update festival (ADMIN; TREASURER may edit budgetGoal/openingBalance)

get.summary: Festival dashboard summary with metrics & recent transactions

post.description: Server assigns the next receipt number under a concurrency-safe lock. Sends Idempotency-Key recommended.

get.summary: Get a single vargani / digital receipt

post.description: Keeps audit trail, reverses fund impact. Errors: ALREADY_CANCELLED, HISAB_LOCKED.

post.summary: Upload signature image to a receipt (multipart)

get.summary: List receipt books for a festival

post.summary: Assign/re-assign a book to a collector (ADMIN/TREASURER)
Create an expense (ADMIN/TREASURER) — multipart or JSON
post.description: Either billFile OR billPendingReason is required. Idempotency-Key recommended.

patch.description: Blocked when HISAB_LOCKED. Amount/paymentMode may only change while PENDING.

patch.summary: Mark a pending expense as PAID (ADMIN/TREASURER)

post.summary: Submit a cash handover (COLLECTOR/ADMIN) — multipart with PIN
Invite/add a member (ADMIN) — links existing user or creates stub

get.summary: Member financial summary (collections, handovers, assigned book)
Reports overview with income/expense chart points
Final hisab statement with audit signatures (ADMIN/TREASURER)

post.summary: Sign final hisab (ADMIN president / TREASURER). Locks when both signed.

200.description: Signed. isLocked=true when both parties signed

get.summary: Download final hisab PDF — binary response

post.summary: Push offline queued operations (idempotent by clientUuid)

code.description: One of: VALIDATION_FAILED, UNAUTHORIZED, TOKEN_EXPIRED, FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, ALREADY_CANCELLED, HANDOVER_NOT_PENDING, HISAB_LOCKED, RECEIPT_BOOK_EXHAUSTED, INVALID_PIN, BIOMETRIC_ATTESTATION_FAILED, FILE_TOO_LARGE, UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE, RATE_LIMITED, MAINTENANCE_MODE, INTERNAL_ERROR

bearerAuth.description: JWT Bearer token. Obtain by calling POST /api/v1/auth/login
